description: Still a finger and a half

participation.context: Paid threepence, sent no letter, began no play, and left the sentence alone.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the finger and a half and the penny, took the threepence, and stopped a better answer.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Set the loaf by the notch, not on a pan, and left Gib where he was.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Mentioned the large moon and asked for no meaning.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: the loaf, and the sentence left at the table
relations.quote: do not improve your wife's sentence.

story.body: You saw the same short loaf and did not argue it. You left the coffer shut. You left the cat on the book. You did not improve Anne's sentence, and you did not give a better answer.

relations.note: the loaf, and the sentence left at the table
relations.quote: do not improve your wife's sentence.

title: Paid threepence for the short loaf

participation.context: Read the line, and added nothing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You let the printed line stand. You did not start a king under it.

title: Read the full moon in the almanac
